mentions.name: RapidCAM.app
mentions.description: A 2.5D parametric CAD/CAM program for CNC and laser machining, supporting flat or 4th axis work. It is open source, free, and runs entirely in the browser. Its file system is open and well-defined so AI can write files, and it includes an AI Assistant dialog that helps write prompts and runs the AI-generated file through a solver to check it.
mentions.source_excerpt: RapidCAM.app is still taking up all my time.  It is a 2.5D, parametric CAD/CAM program for CNC and laser with flat or 4th axis.  Open source, free, run completely in browser.
